test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS 2024 - General Awareness (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Select the INCORRECT statement.

options.text: Functional segments of DNA are called genes.
The chromatin material gets organised into rod-shaped chromosomes only when the cell is about to divide.
Chromosomes are composed of DNA and carbohydrates.
DNA molecules contain the information necessary for constructing and organising cells.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Chromosomes are composed of DNA and carbohydrates**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Functional segments of DNA are called genes.**

 
 
• Genes are specific sequences of nucleotides within DNA molecules.
 
• They encode instructions for the synthesis of proteins or RNA molecules.
 
• Genes are the basic units of heredity and determine various traits.
 
• Each gene occupies a specific location on a chromosome.
